items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I knew him. I never heard him play much, but I talked to him a couple of times. He was a good pianist. Nice piano. [INTERVIEWEE] He arranged, too.

ctx.x: And, uh, Albert Wynn played pretty nice, I thought. Yeah. Nice, uh. He doesn't work much. Like I said, there aren't many bands here Chicago that do use a trombone unless they... No, there is a trombone. Oh, no. Just about to. I think we'd better quit. Dave Payton, yes, I heard that Dave Payton died. I knew him. I never heard him play much, but I talked to him a couple of times. He was a good pianist. Nice piano.
